messages.subject: project overview via ctrl F8  in windows 10
parts: Dear friends - in my old windows 7 ctrl F8 iopens a l´very useful list oover projects and makes it very simple to manipulate contents of projects. However on windows 10 ctrl F8 opens  a presentation over all open windows but not the handle to tinn-r projects. How can I do the same now?
